title: Two Things at Once
label: ch:bn-two-things-at-once
canDo: I can put two nouns in one sentence with আর, mark either of them with -ও, offer a choice between them with বা, and refuse both with না … না.

payoff.summary: The colours, foods and family words of eleven earlier chapters, joined two at a time for the first time: added with আর, marked with -ও, offered with বা, and refused with না … না.
payoff.note: The payoff is the whole taught noun inventory becoming combinable, not the four joiners on their own.
